main_reasons: OTC shell with about $3.6K of assets bought a PRC operating group (AI UltraProd) for Series A preferred valued at $8.6M off a thinly traded OTC price that went from $0.25 to $5; most of the price went to goodwill ($6.0M) and patents ($3.7M), with no independent valuation support disclosed

Classic Chinese reverse-merger warning signs: large advances to suppliers ($3.35M, more than the AR balance), AR of $3.1M with no credit-loss allowance, no inventory reserve, and operating cash outflow despite reported profit

Revenue is unclear: 'FY2025 revenue (audited) $7.7M' for AI UltraProd equals the consolidated revenue, which is supposed to include only the post-June 23 period, so pre-acquisition revenue may have been included

Many internal inconsistencies: 2024 net loss of $409,440 vs $258,892 and 2024 opex of $414,400 vs $265,868; founder shares cancelled 100.1M vs 130.1M; valuation allowance opening balance does not match the prior year; subsequent-event dates (2025 vs 2026); related-party note balances differ; MD&A misdescribes investing and financing cash flows
Small, newly engaged Hong Kong auditor (Gary Cheng CPA, first year) replaced the prior auditor; the audit report has formatting and CAM oddities, with going concern used as the only CAM

Weak governance: two-person board made up entirely of insiders, no audit committee, CFO with no evident accounting background, material weaknesses since inception, and control held through super-voting preferred (10,000 votes per share) obtained via related-party share exchanges and a 100M-share debt conversion at $0.0005

Signs of stock promotion and dilution: investor-awareness campaigns, Bitcoin treasury plans, toxic variable-price convertible notes at 60% of the lowest price, consultant share issuances, and a NASDAQ uplisting push
Contingent consideration was booked in equity using a subjective 10% probability; equity accounting for the share exchanges and the acquisition is questionable
